title: Restore Tauri Local API response CORS headers
summary: Ensure Local API JSON/static responses include authorized CORS response headers so the Tauri WebView can read backend responses.
reason: The Tauri shell loads the WebView from tauri://localhost while the Local API serves http://127.0.0.1:<port>. OPTIONS preflight already allowed this origin, but actual responses lacked Access-Control-Allow-Origin, causing browser fetch calls such as settings save and backend snapshot reads to fail as unreadable cross-origin responses.
behavior_before: Authorized Tauri-origin fetches could pass preflight but fail with Failed to fetch because actual Local API responses did not carry CORS allow-origin headers.
behavior_after: Authorized Tauri-origin fetches receive matching Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Vary headers on actual Local API responses while existing host/origin/auth checks remain in place.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m pytest tests/webview/test_webview_settings_patch_smoke.py -q - failed: pre-existing dirty settingsView.js changed expected preview guidance text
rollback_plan: Revert the Local API handler/header helper changes and this packet. Browser-served same-origin WebView use would continue to work, but Tauri-origin fetches would again be blocked by browser CORS enforcement.
notes:
Add authorized CORS headers to actual Local API responses for Tauri-origin fetches.
Focused tests passed; WebView settings patch smoke remains blocked by existing Settings UI wording drift outside this API CORS fix.
Strict coverage passed with no uncovered dirty files reported by validate_changes.
